name: RapVid
summary: Turns photos into short AI rap videos, with a free first clip, one-time credit packs from 5 € and monthly plans from 12 €.
description: RapVid generates solo, duo or battle-style AI rap videos from photos. A standard 12-second 720p video is 25 credits; failed renders are refunded. Official pricing: the first 5-second clip is free (480p with a RapVid watermark, one per account).

pricing.details: First 5-second watermarked clip free (one per account). One-time packs that never expire: 5 € (25 credits), 13 € (100), 36 € (300), 89 € (800). Lite 12 €/month (100 credits); Pro 27 €/month (250 credits). Monthly credits do not roll over. Failed renders are refunded.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Photo-to-rap-video in solo, duo or battle styles
One-time packs that never expire, plus monthly plans
